newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar falls below 116 yen in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar falls below 116 yen in Tokyo.

text.p: The dollar dipped below 116 yen in the morning Tokyo on Thursday, the lowest level since January 13, dealers said.
Dealers said the greenback fell sharply after setting off stop-loss sales near 116.50 yen. U.S. funds and trust banks were said to be main sellers in morning trade.
The dollar dipped as low as around 115.85 yen, but soon recovered above 116 yen.

The dollar began falling in New York after weaker-than-expected economic data released on Wednesday dimmed expectations of a Federal Reserve credit tightening at a Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting next week.
Dealers said psychological support was expected at 115 yen, but added that there was no clear reason why dollar should stop falling there.
